description: Click-triggered floating panel for RICH content: a form, a group of controls, a detail card. <Tooltip> is text on hover, <Dropdown> is a menu of items; this is neither. Closes on outside click or Escape, returning focus to the trigger. The content is a labelled role="dialog". Copy: the accessible name says what the panel holds, because it is a dialog and announces itself before its content.

props.name: trigger
props.description: Render the control that opens the popover; spread the given props onto it.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the popover dialog.

props.name: placement
props.description: Preferred side; flips to the other if there is not enough room. Default 'bottom'.

example:
<Row gap={3} align="center">
  
  <Popover
    label="Quick filter"
    placement="bottom"
    trigger={(props) => <Button variant="secondary" {...props}>Filter</Button>}
  >
    <Stack gap={3}>
      <Field label="Minimum amount" htmlFor="min">
        <Input id="min" type="number" placeholder="0" />
      </Field>
      <Button variant="primary" block>Apply</Button>
    </Stack>
  </Popover>
  <Popover
    label="Sort"
    placement="top"
    trigger={(props) => <Button variant="ghost" {...props}>Sort</Button>}
  >
    <Stack gap={2}>
      <Button variant="link">Newest first</Button>
      <Button variant="link">Oldest first</Button>
    </Stack>
  </Popover>
</Row>
